instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, full shot. On a white studio floor, three women sit huddled together. On the left, the woman with wavy light-brown hair (R3) in a black crop top, white unbuttoned shirt, and blue jeans sits barefoot, looking at the camera with a soft smile. In the center, the woman with long straight dark hair (R2) in a white top and denim jacket sits smiling forward. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a white shirt and blue jeans sits barefoot, leaning into R2 with her eyes closed and a happy smile. Bright, soft lighting illuminates the clean, minimalist setting.
